title: Hatsune Miku — Original Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Welcome back to another episode of “Get on Those Hot Topics!”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Let's jump straight in and give a warm welcome to our special guest.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
Today's guest is none other than...
VIRTUAL SINGER Hatsune Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello, everyone! I'm Hatsune Miku.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: As it turns out, Miku will be performing in the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show, set to be held in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Social media was ablaze with excitement as soon as the show was announced!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Starting today, in the lead-up to the show, we'll be interviewing each of the VIRTUAL SINGERS set to appear!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And Miku is our top batter!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you for having me!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Let me begin with a short bio.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hatsune Miku is one of the world-famous VIRTUAL SINGERS.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Her long pigtails are not only instantly recognizable, but also adorable.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That's very kind of you.
I'm glad I made an effort today♪>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: You did? You make it look effortless!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Now then, I think we'd all agree that there are a great deal of people with strong feelings about our cute, mischievous Miku and the songs she sings.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: With that in mind, we took to the streets and asked folks the question: “What are your Hatsune Miku memories?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I've been looking forward to hearing the responses to this.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Is that so? Well then, let's get to it!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: My memories of Miku? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: So, I was told I didn't have a shot at getting into my first choice of high school after I did badly on a practice exam. I was feeling really down...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: But then I found a video online of Miku singing, and the song was really motivating. I listened to it all the time while I was studying.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Miku!
Thanks to your song, I pulled it together and scraped my way into the high school I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe, that's great!
Congratulations on passing, and have fun in high school!>

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Huh, memories of Miku?
I have too many to count!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: She was there to comfort me when I got my heart broken, and she gave me courage when I decided to tell my crush that I liked him.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, and she has a show coming up, right?
I'm gonna bring my boyfriend along to see you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And those were our street interview clips! How was that for you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm so glad to see that my singing has helped people.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <All of my songs are labors of love by various creators.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So I'm very happy to know that they've reached so many people.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We also heard this story.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It's from four girls who attend a high school in Shibuya and are in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Their original inspiration for forming the band was to perform your songs, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, really?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's surprising to learn that I've even inspired people to start something new like that.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It seems that's actually happened more often than you might think.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We encountered all sorts of people inspired by you during our interviews, from those who decided to become singers to those who picked up an instrument!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really? I'm so happy to hear that.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It would be nice to sing on stage with those people one day...!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That would be nice indeed!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Well, as much as we could keep chatting forever, we have an important announcement to make! Miku, would you do the honors?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Of course!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're looking for your “Miku memories”, like the ones you heard just now, for the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Check out the official website for more details♪ I can't wait to hear from you!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And tomorrow's guest is—>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Miku, tomorrow's guest is a secret, don't forget.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oops, I forgot!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Those itching to find out will have to tune in tomorrow for Get on Those Hot Topics!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: On that note, Miku, could you please round us off with a message for our viewers?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everyone, thank you for watching this first installment in the interview series♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We've been working hard to put together a show that a lot of people can enjoy, so you won't be disappointed!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Maybe even I'll take the day off and go see the show.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And with that, all that's left to say is...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Host
rows.Line:
<Goodbye!>
Goodbye!
